headline: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson (ankle) vs. Bengals; Tyler 'Snoop' Huntley to start
summary: The Baltimore Ravens have ruled QB Lamar Jackson out of Sundays game vs. the Cincinnati Bengals as he continues to deal with a high ankle sprain. Tyler "Snoop" Huntley will get the start.

headline: Eagles' DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks out vs. Cowboys
summary: The Eagles' top two receivers -- DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks -- have been ruled out of Monday night's game against the Cowboys.

headline: Giants CB Paulson Adebo Activated Off IR
summary: The Giants will get some much-needed reinforcement in their secondary this weekend. According to Dan Duggan of The Athletic, one of New York’s five cornerbacks on injured reserve has been activated, and that cornerback is starter Paulson Adebo. headline: Without tight end Cole Kmet, Bears may run more jumbo six-lineman formations
summary: Bears tight end Cole Kmet suffered a season-ending knee injury on Thursday night, and the Bears' plan for replacing him could entail putting more offensive linemen on the field.

headline: Texans activate WR Tank Dell to the active roster
summary: Tank Dell will play his first game in nearly two years on Sunday when the Texans play the Giants.
